settings.h1: Knitted blankets from rescued luxury yarn
settings.intro: Every blanket is knitted from unused yarn left over from fashion production, in our family factory. Timeless, soft and textured, for cosy, conscious living. Each design is a numbered edition of 12 to 25 pieces, sized from 100 × 150 to 120 × 160 cm. Free delivery and free returns within Denmark.
settings.label: 8 sec clip: blankets being knitted on the machine

settings.heading: How to choose the right blanket

settings.title: Size
settings.text: Our blankets run from 100 × 150 cm, good for a lap, a stroller or a cot, to 120 × 160 cm, which covers a sofa seat or the foot of a double bed.

settings.title: Yarn
settings.text: Lambswool blends for warmth and shape. Lambswool and hemp for weight and texture. Organic and recycled cotton for babies, all year use and machine washing.

settings.title: Care
settings.text: Lambswool pieces are hand wash cold and dry flat. Cotton pieces can go in the machine on a cold, gentle cycle.

settings.q: Does leftover yarn mean lower quality?
settings.a: Not at all. Many of our yarns were made for premium fashion and retail brands, including cotton, wool and specialist blends. The only reason they remain is quantity, not quality.
Our pieces are made in small quantities from leftover yarn that exists in limited amounts. Once that yarn is used, the same design or colour may not be repeated.
Some items may return in a new colourway or updated design, but once sold out they are not restocked exactly the same. If a piece speaks to you, it may be best to make it yours while it is available.
